# Leave Policy

Applies to every employee of Smoke Test Co.

## Earned leave

Full-time employees get 18 days of earned leave per calendar year, credited monthly. Up to 30 days of earned leave can be carried forward to the next year.

## Sick leave

Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave a year. A doctor's certificate is needed for more than 3 consecutive sick days.

## Parental leave

Birth mothers get 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Fathers and partners get 2 weeks of paid paternity leave within 6 months of the birth.
